Execute a sequence of multiple actions (click, type, click) and verify all succeed with correct indices

```dart title="Dart"
import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';
import 'package:crawlberg/crawlberg.dart';
import 'package:crawlberg/src/crawlberg_bridge_generated/frb_generated.dart' show RustLib;
Future<void> main() async {
  await RustLib.init();
  try {
    final engineConfig = await createCrawlConfigFromJson(json: r'{"browser":{"mode":"always"}}');
    final engine = await CrawlbergBridge.createEngine(config: engineConfig);
    final url = 'https://example.com';
    final actions = (jsonDecode(r'[{"selector":"#open","type":"click"},{"selector":"#field","text":"test_data","type":"type"},{"selector":"#submit","type":"click"}]') as List<dynamic>).map((e) => _parsePageAction(e as Map<String, dynamic>)).toList();
    final result = await CrawlbergBridge.interact(engine, url, actions);
    stdout.writeln(result.actionResults[0].actionIndex);
    stdout.writeln(result.actionResults[0].actionType);
    stdout.writeln(result.actionResults[0].success);
    stdout.writeln(result.actionResults[1].actionIndex);
    stdout.writeln(result.actionResults[1].actionType);
    stdout.writeln(result.actionResults[1].success);
    stdout.writeln(result.actionResults[2].actionIndex);
    stdout.writeln(result.actionResults[2].actionType);
    stdout.writeln(result.actionResults[2].success);
  } finally {
    RustLib.dispose();
  }
}
```
